data.name: Safety_Consent_AgentUnavailable

data.name: Safety_Consent_AntiCheat
data.value: Anti-cheat systems may flag or ban accounts. FrameLedger refuses to inject where it detects an anti-cheat, and it cannot guarantee it knows every anti-cheat. If one appears after injection, capture stops within 30 seconds of it being detected.

data.name: Safety_Consent_Enable
data.value: Enable hooking

data.name: Safety_Consent_Hooked
data.value: If you enable hooking (Tier 1): the session records every frame's time, the native and displayed frame rates, the render and output resolutions, the upscaler and its quality mode, frame generation, ray tracing, and the hardware telemetry this machine provides.

data.name: Safety_Consent_Injected
data.value: What is injected, and why: FrameLedger.Overlay.dll is loaded into the game process to measure, from inside it, the real render resolution, the upscaler and its quality mode, whether frame generation is active and by how much, and whether ray tracing is in use. Measuring from outside the process cannot establish these accurately.

data.name: Safety_Consent_Intro
data.value: Hooking loads a FrameLedger library into this game's process. This dialog states what that means for this game. It recommends neither choice.

data.name: Safety_Consent_KeepOff
data.value: Keep hooking off

data.name: Safety_Consent_NotHooked
data.value: If you do not enable hooking (Tier 2): the session records its start, end and duration, and the hardware telemetry this machine provides. Every frame-derived value on that session reads N/A. This needs no injection and no elevation, and it is what every game gets until it is individually enabled here.

data.name: Safety_Consent_Phrase
data.value: I ACCEPT THE INJECTION RISK

data.name: Safety_Consent_Terms

data.name: Safety_Refused_CouldNotVerify
data.value: FrameLedger could not verify this game's files for anti-cheat, so hooking stays off. It will check again when the game's files or the detection rules change.

data.name: Safety_Refused_Named_Format
data.value: {0} was detected in this game ({1}). FrameLedger will not inject into it. The only way past this is that game's own guard-bypass switch, which is off by default and entirely at your own risk.

data.name: Safety_Refused_Unnamed
data.value: An anti-cheat or anti-tamper module was detected in this game. FrameLedger will not inject into it. The only way past this is that game's own guard-bypass switch, which is off by default and entirely at your own risk.

data.name: Safety_Unhooked_Format
data.value: Capture stopped: {0} was detected while the game was running. FrameLedger unhooked and will not inject into this game again until you enable it again.

data.name: Safety_Bypass_Title_Format
data.value: Bypass the anti-cheat guard for {0}?

data.name: Safety_Bypass_Intro
data.value: FrameLedger refuses to inject into a game where it detects anti-cheat or anti-tamper software. This switch overrules that refusal for this one game. It is OFF by default, it applies to no other game, and you can turn it off again at any time. It cannot make FrameLedger work where an anti-cheat protects the game's process from being opened: such a game stays unmeasured, FrameLedger will not work around that protection, and you would carry the ban risk for nothing.

data.name: Safety_Bypass_Found_Format
data.value: What the guard found for this game: {0}

data.name: Safety_Bypass_Found_Nothing
data.value: The guard has not recorded a finding for this game yet. With the bypass on, a finding it makes later will no longer stop hooking.

data.name: Safety_Bypass_Risk
data.value: WHAT CAN HAPPEN. Anti-cheat systems treat a DLL loaded into the game as tampering, whatever it does. Your account can be flagged, kicked, suspended or PERMANENTLY BANNED, in this game and possibly in others from the same publisher or platform, without warning and without appeal. FrameLedger does not hide from anti-cheat and never will: the overlay loads under its real name and is fully visible to it. The game may also crash, refuse to start, or lose unsaved progress.

data.name: Safety_Bypass_Liability
data.value: BY TURNING THIS ON, YOU ACCEPT THE ENTIRE RISK YOURSELF. The developers and contributors of FrameLedger accept NO responsibility and NO liability for anything that happens on your side as a result: not for a banned or suspended account, not for lost purchases, progress or data, not for any other loss. If you are not certain, keep the guard on.

data.name: Safety_Bypass_Recorded
data.value: Every session started under the bypass is marked as such, permanently, in the library, in exports and in bug reports, together with what the guard found. Turning hooking off, or the game's executable changing, turns the bypass off again.

data.name: Safety_Bypass_Checkbox

data.name: Safety_Refused_TargetUnreadable
data.value: The game is running, but Windows would not let FrameLedger open its process: it is protected by an anti-cheat driver, or it runs as administrator while FrameLedger does not. Nothing was injected and this run was not measured. The guard bypass does not change this, and FrameLedger will not work around another product's protection.
